name: ainative-flow-v2
description: Artifact-gated workflow with continuous orchestration from human brainstorming through integration evidence

interface.longDescription: A continuous orchestrator plus eight explicit stages with human brainstorming and intent confirmation, traceable artifacts, TDD implementation, and separate integration evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use $dev-run to detect and continuously orchestrate the Flow v2 stages.
Use $dev-plan to create an executable plan.md.
Use $dev-code for TDD implementation and unit tests.
Use $dev-qc with a QCRequest to coordinate independent Flow checks.
